title: Second-class in town while prisoners had more rights
summary: He could only go into the Negro section of Greensboro while a German prisoner had more rights.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: Could you go into town and?

Oh, yeah, could go into town, but go in the town, but you go in the Negro section of town. And, Lida, I'm telling you, it was so stupid, you know, when you stop and think about it, like here I am, I'm in the Air Force, I'm supposed to be an American soldier, right? And there's a prisoner of war and he had more rights in the town than I did. You know. Mainly because he's German.
He's a Caucasian. So that shows you, you know, stupidity, you know.
